expected_behavior: `fslc db check` must propagate any non-verdict verification failure (including internal exit status 3) unchanged. Only verification statuses 0 and 1 may be merged into the database-check envelope.
spec_queries: verification exit status 3 specialized command envelope
database check run_verify non-verdict status contract
test_patch:
diff --git a/rust/fslc/tests/reviewgraphen_generated_calibration_09.rs b/rust/fslc/tests/reviewgraphen_generated_calibration_09.rs
new file mode 100644
--- /dev/null
+++ b/rust/fslc/tests/reviewgraphen_generated_calibration_09.rs
@@ -0,0 +1,20 @@
+// SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+
+#[test]
+fn reviewgraphen_generated_regression() {
+    let source = include_str!("../src/main.rs");
+    let start = source.find("fn run_db_check(").expect("run_db_check");
+    let function = source
+        .get(start..)
+        .and_then(|tail| tail.split_once("\nfn run_db_observe(").map(|(body, _)| body))
+        .expect("run_db_check body");
+
+    assert!(
+        function.contains("if kernel_status >= 2 {")
+            || function.contains("if kernel_status > 1 {"),
+        "db check must propagate internal verification failures"
+    );
+    assert!(
+        !function.contains("if kernel_status == 2 {"),
+        "status 3 must not be wrapped as a database-check result"
+    );
+}
